description: Walk the guided path to build a nifra app end to end - an ORDERED sequence (create → page route → loader → typed API → typed client → auth → background jobs → deploy), not the random-access search of nifra_docs/nifra_example. Call with no args for the step index; pass `step: N` for that step's goal, how to do it (which tool emits the correct artifact), and how to verify it. Use it when scaffolding a new app or learning nifra's flow - each step composes the other nifra_* tools.

step.description: 1-based step number to expand (omit for the index).

name: nifra_learn
